because they have ripped up{H1234} the women with child{H2030} of Gilead,{H1568} that they may enlarge{H7337} their border.{H1366} 14 But I will kindle{H3341} a fire{H784} in the wall{H2346} of Rabbah,{H7237} and it shall devour{H398} the palaces{H759} thereof, with shouting{H8643} in the day{H3117} of battle,{H4421} with a tempest{H5591} in the day{H3117} of the whirlwind;{H5492} 15 and their king{H4428} shall go{H1980} into captivity,{H1473} he and his princes{H8269} together,{H3162} saith{H559} Jehovah.{H3068}
